item.title: Don't Use TAB
item.body:
Type: Bug I really dislike how copilot's autosuggestions make it difficult to indent my text. I get that enter/return is necessary to add space, space bars as fequently used, and that tab seems 'convenient.' It isn't. Can you please change it to the right arrow or something less common?
